# rubrik_aws_rcv_archival_location (Resource)

The `rubrik_aws_rcv_archival_location` resource is used to create and manage RCV
AWS archival locations in RSC.

Rubrik Cloud Vault, RCV, is Rubrik hosted archival storage. The cloud account
and the storage container are owned by Rubrik, so no cloud account ID is needed,
only a region and a tier.

-> **Note:** When `region` is left out, the archival location follows the region
   of the workload being archived, and `location_template` becomes
   `SOURCE_REGION` instead of `SPECIFIC_REGION`.

-> **Note:** RSC only supports updating the `name` and the `tier`. Changing any
   other argument replaces the archival location.

-> **Note:** Encryption defaults to a key RCV creates and manages. The `kms_key`
   block selects client-side encryption with an AWS KMS key instead, and the
   `customer_provided_key` block selects server-side encryption with an AES key
   you supply. The two blocks are mutually exclusive.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Archival location in a specific region.
resource "rubrik_aws_rcv_archival_location" "archive" {
  name   = "us-east-1-archive"
  region = "us-east-1"
  tier   = "BACKUP"
}

# Archival location following the region of the workload being archived.
resource "rubrik_aws_rcv_archival_location" "source_region_archive" {
  name = "source-region-archive"
  tier = "ARCHIVE"
}

# Client-side encryption with a customer managed KMS key.
resource "rubrik_aws_rcv_archival_location" "kms_archive" {
  name       = "us-east-1-kms-archive"
  region     = "us-east-1"
  tier       = "BACKUP"
  redundancy = "MULTI_ZONE"

  kms_key {
    key_manager_id = "8d2d0ee8-6b5a-4a58-b2a1-cd0b5f4ee2a4"
    key_id         = "9c3f1b3e-9f2a-4c05-9d3f-1f2d0a5b8e77"
  }
}

# Server-side encryption with a customer provided AES key, generated with
# `openssl rand -base64 32`. The key is write-only, so it never reaches Terraform
# state and can be sourced from a secret manager or an ephemeral variable.
variable "archive_aes_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "rubrik_aws_rcv_archival_location" "cpk_archive" {
  name   = "us-east-1-cpk-archive"
  region = "us-east-1"
  tier   = "BACKUP"

  customer_provided_key {
    key = var.archive_aes_key

    # RSC only accepts the key when the archival location is created. Change the
    # version to replace the archival location with one using a new key.
    version = "1"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Archival location name.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `customer_provided_key` (Block List) Customer provided AES key used for server-side encryption of the archived data. Conflicts with `kms_key`. When neither is given, RCV creates and manages the encryption key. May be specified at most once. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--customer_provided_key))
- `kms_key` (Block List) AWS KMS key used for client-side encryption of the archived data. Conflicts with `customer_provided_key`. When neither is given, RCV creates and manages the encryption key. May be specified at most once. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--kms_key))
- `redundancy` (String) Storage redundancy. Possible values are `SINGLE_ZONE`, `MULTI_ZONE` and `MULTI_REGION`. Changing this forces a new resource to be created, the RSC API does not support updating it.
- `region` (String) AWS region hosting the vault, e.g. `us-east-1`. When left out, the archival location follows the region of the workload being archived. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `tier` (String) Storage tier. Possible values are `BACKUP` and `ARCHIVE`.

### Read-Only

- `connection_status` (String) Connection status of the archival location.
- `encryption_type` (String) Encryption mode RSC applied to the archival location. Possible values are `SSE_CPK` and `UEKM_AWS_KMS_BASED`.
- `id` (String) Archival location ID (UUID).
- `location_template` (String) Location template. `SPECIFIC_REGION` when `region` is specified, otherwise `SOURCE_REGION`.

<a id="nestedblock--customer_provided_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `customer_provided_key`

Required:

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) AES-256 key, base64 encoded. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`. Write-only, so it never reaches Terraform state. RSC only accepts the key when the archival location is created, change `version` to replace the archival location with one using a new key.
- `version` (String) Arbitrary value identifying the version of `key`. Write-only arguments produce no difference in the plan on their own, so changing this is what makes a new key take effect.


<a id="nestedblock--kms_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kms_key`

Required:

- `key_id` (String) KMS key ID.
- `key_manager_id` (String) KMS key manager ID (UUID).
